routing_note: Scores below are transparent 0-5 research-routing scores, not probabilities and not proof evidence.

candidates.exact_claim_or_objective: Any standard Beal Frey curve with multiplicative reduction at a solution-variable prime has an order-p transvection on E[p], hence its mod-p image cannot lie in a Cartan normalizer.
candidates.method: Audit the local Tate-curve hypothesis against the valuation of the minimal discriminant.
evidence: Clay Mathematics Proceedings 8, Charollois, Generalized Fermat equations (d'apres Halberstadt-Kraus), pp. 92-94: the local symplectic/Tate argument assumes p does not divide v_q(Delta), and the p-torsion inertia becomes trivial over the maximal unramified field when p divides the Tate parameter valuation.
For the repository's displayed (2,3,p) model Delta=-1728*C^p, any q|C with q not in {2,3} has v_q(Delta)=p*v_q(C), hence 0 mod p before any possible minimal-model correction.
Wolfram exact arithmetic check on Delta=-1728*(q^2)^p for p in {5,7,11,17}, q in {5,7,11,13}: every q-adic valuation is 2p and is 0 mod p.
unresolved_obligations: This refutes the universal argument, not every signature-specific irreducibility theorem.
At fixed coefficient primes and after minimalization, each Frey family needs its own local analysis.
candidates.failure_reason: The route omits the necessary condition p does not divide v_q(Delta_min). At the chosen solution-variable primes, the p-th-power contribution commonly makes that valuation divisible by p.
candidates.novelty_relative_to_pool: Material correction of the latest U110-U111 universal-surjectivity route.

routing.recommended_action: Preserve refutation and invalidate downstream uses of universal transvection-based surjectivity.

candidates.exact_claim_or_objective: Repair the Cartan-elimination idea by locating, for each concrete Frey family, a genuinely multiplicative prime q with p not dividing v_q(Delta_min); only then use the order-p transvection to exclude Cartan normalizers.
inspirations: Valid Cartan group-order computation from U110-U111
candidates.method: Compute minimal discriminant valuations prime-by-prime for specific Frey models, separating solution-variable primes from fixed coefficient primes.
evidence: The group-theoretic implication is valid once an order-p transvection is actually present.
unresolved_obligations: Derive minimal models and reduction type at fixed primes for each target family.
Prove the chosen local prime exists uniformly over every putative solution in the family.
candidates.novelty_relative_to_pool: Repairs rather than repeats the failed universal route by making the missing valuation hypothesis explicit.

routing.recommended_action: Start with one concrete family and audit its minimal discriminant at all fixed bad primes.

candidates.exact_claim_or_objective: Audit the repository claim that X^10 + 256 Y^10 = Z^17 has no primitive positive integer solutions.
candidates.method: Attack the earliest unsupported implication in the U105 dependency chain, beginning with the claimed map from an integer solution to a k-rational point and the stated degree obstruction.
evidence: U105 asserts two independent closure pathways, but the research README still records the weighted equation as unresolved and the checkpoint has not received independent expert or complete formal verification.
unresolved_obligations: Verify the exact curve-to-Diophantine map and its field of definition.
Verify that the Coleman computation classifies k-rational points rather than points over an extension generated by the solution.
Verify the Hilbert newspace inventory and level-lowering hypotheses independently.
candidates.novelty_relative_to_pool: Not a new route; high leverage because it audits the strongest claimed branch closure.

routing.recommended_action: Audit the claimed degree-10 obstruction first.

candidates.exact_claim_or_objective: Search for explicit Beal counterexamples in the bounded pure-prime region already covered through bases 140000 and exponents <=19.
candidates.method: Exact finite enumeration with arbitrary-precision verification.
evidence: U112 records zero counterexamples in its stated bounded domain.
unresolved_obligations: No finite bound currently reduces the full conjecture to this search domain.
candidates.failure_reason: Further blind range extension has low information gain without a named structural hypothesis.

routing.recommended_action: Deprioritize until a structural conjecture identifies a discriminating new range.

candidates.exact_claim_or_objective: Develop a uniform local-congruence/valuation obstruction for unresolved mixed prime signatures after the project's independent exponent reduction, without assuming a universal Frey curve.
candidates.method: Classify primitive residue/valuation patterns first, then test only lemmas that remove an infinite signature class.
evidence: Primitive solutions are pairwise coprime; several parity classes are already excluded by elementary 2-adic arguments.
unresolved_obligations: Find a local invariant strong enough to eliminate an infinite unresolved signature family rather than isolated residue classes.
candidates.novelty_relative_to_pool: Material restart away from the recent modular-surjectivity overgeneralization.

routing.recommended_action: Generate a precise candidate lemma and immediately countersearch it modulo small prime powers.
